units: <cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Exodus 32:20">Targ. Y. Ex. XXXII, 20</cite>.
Targ. O. Num. XXXII, 3, v. סוּמָא II.—Esp. pl. סִימְוָון, סִימְוָן, סִימְוָותָא, סִימְוָאתָא, סִמְ׳ military ensigns, standards.
<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Jeremiah 4:21">Targ. Jer. IV, 21</cite> (Bxt. <cite ref="O00710"><he>סִימָן</he></cite>). Targ.

<cite ref="Habakkuk 1:16">Hab. I, 16</cite>; a. fr.—Meg. Taan. IX, beg. <he>איתנטלו ס׳ וכ׳</he> the (foreign) insignia were removed from the Temple; expl. ib. as referring to Greek idolatrous emblems (<cite ref="O00690"><he>סִימְוָאוֹת</he></cite>). [The peculiar application of our w. is caused by the adaptation of σῆμα a. σημαία.]
